added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest (r-20261013T002012798972-ssfms-reembed-census) names no baseline_suite or after_suite gate log, so no base/head suite delta was taken; its own recorded gate is tests/discovery/test_signal_embedding_sweep.py 3 passed at head (logs/gate_head.log) against 3 failed under the null-blind mutation (logs/negative_control.log).

findings.text: signal_embed_text duplicates _default_embed_text (parallel.py:1536) — the writer derives its embed text via _default_embed_text while the census derives it via signal_embed_text; the two bodies are identical today so the census selects the sweep rows, but a future change to the embed-text decision applied to only one of them would make the census and the writer disagree about which rows are stale, and the docstring claim to be the one place the choice is expressed is not true.

the tests exercise a hand-written _SweepGraph that parses the Cypher string and re-implements null semantics in _cypher_predicate_matches (line 42), so the real statement never runs — a syntax or arm-ordering regression in parallel.py write statements would leave all three tests green.

the done-when golden-harness non-regression measure (no lower beyond the 0.012 spread) was not produced — the current_tool arm refused on the unlabelled candidate jt-60sa:general/psc_cref3snu and no base arm was run, so the clause is unmeasured rather than shown to hold; carried for the fixture owner.
